meta.title: Spring Boneアニメーション処理の最適化: get_bone_name関数のキャッシュ実装の改善
meta.body_summary: Simplify get_bone_name cache by removing a secondary cache layer for cross-platform compatibility, but provided benchmarks show a slight performance regression (2.629s → 2.692s).

perf_labels.notes: Devin simplified cache but benchmark showed slight slowdown (2.629s→2.692s); maintainer closed within 28min with no comment.
